info.name: Account Account API Competitors API API

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain to analyze for paid search competitors.

params.name: countryCode
params.description: Country market to search. Specifically, this maps to the Google domain version to query against (e.g., google.com for US, google.de for Germany, etc.). All Countries

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of rows returned.

params.name: startingRow
params.description: Row number to start the results with.

items.docs:
Returns the top paid search (PPC) competitors for a domain based on shared keyword advertising overlap. This endpoint identifies domains that compete for the same paid keywords to reveal direct advertising competition and bidding opportunities.

[Visualize this API live on SpyFu](https://www.spyfu.com/ppc/competitors?query=example.com)

items.docs:
Returns the top competitors for a domain combining both paid search (PPC) and organic search (SEO) data. This endpoint identifies domains that compete across both advertising and organic rankings to reveal comprehensive competitive landscape insights.

[Visualize this API live on SpyFu](https://www.spyfu.com/competitors?query=example.com)
